hook.name: PoolStrategyHooks
hook.description: Manages Uniswap v4 liquidity pools for NFT strategy collections, gating initialization and liquidity addition to a designated factory. Charges a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, decaying to 10% over blocks) and a fixed 10% sell fee, distributing ETH proceeds to the NFT vault, collection owner, and protocol fee address.
